(1) No, there is no central sign-in card or modal with buttons like 'Sign in with ChatGPT'. Instead, there is a warning box about a connection failure to the Codex app-server.

(2) The main area content consists of the heading "What should we work on?", the subtext "Start a new chat or open one from the sidebar.", and a yellow warning box that states: "Couldn't connect to the Codex app-server. Install and sign in to the official Codex CLI. If it isn't on PATH, set CODEX_RS_CODEX_BIN, then retry." This box includes a "Retry" button. At the bottom of the main area is an input field with the placeholder "Ask Codex to change, inspect, or explain...".

(3) The bottom-left status says: "Connection failed".
